name: Iowa State University
header:
Iowa State University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Fee deferred until enrollment, not permanently waived.
• Referee invitations occur only after submission.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
International U.S.-degree applicants contemplated; UChicago bachelor’s is a relevant route. Exact program
GPA/prerequisites must be checked with program. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Submit application early: referee invitations only sent after submission/fee if applicable. Math defers fee until
enrollment. Required supplemental applicant-information Word form must additionally be emailed/mailed;
linked Box file was inaccessible. [s1] [s2] [s5]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
No public requirement to secure an adviser before submitting was established in the admissions pages
checked. Use the research-fit shortlist for potential contacts and confirm 2027 availability/graduate supervision
eligibility. A faculty listing does not promise an opening. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Admissions MyAccount for uploads/status/references after submission. Uploaded documents can be
supplemented but not removed; separate program applications each need materials. [s2] [s3]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Standing February 1; no explicit Fall 2027 date; stipend undated. [s1] [s4]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
February 1 for full fall consideration; year and time zone not specified. [s1]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Full consideration requires all materials by February 1; specific fellowship deadlines unverified. [s1]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Use February 1 full-materials date; no separate letter grace found. [s1]
Test-score receipt [Conflict]
Department asks official English scores before February 1 and 3-4 weeks transit; central FAQ permits unofficial
evaluation then official if admitted. Confirm math application requirement. [s1] [s2]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
February 1 full consideration. Official finals promptly after offer: if degree complete, within 4 weeks;
registration hold if missing by 10thday of term. [s1] [s2]

Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Accept/decline through MyAccount; no acceptance fee. Current commitment date not established; offer
controls. [s2]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Math old TOEFL 79,IELTS 7,PTE 53,DET 115. Central updated TOEFL 4.5 for tests from Jan 21, 2026; central
IELTS 6.5 is lower than math’s7. NoTSE/TWE required. [s1] [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Math exempts bachelor’s/master’s earned at U.S.institution. Completed UChicago degree qualifies; expected
degree at application needs confirmation. [s1]
GRE General [Standing rule]
No longer required. Voluntary-score consideration not explicitly settled. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
GRE generally not required; separate mathematics-test recommendation/consideration not stated. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three able to assess mathematical potential; REU supervisor encouraged. Nonmathematical letters may be
additional, not replace three. [s1]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
This specific reference detail was not established by the public program/graduate application instructions
checked. Confirm it in the current referee-help screen or with admissions before entering contacts; no
invitation was triggered during research. [s1] [s2] [s3]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
ONLY after application submitted and fee paid if applicable; math’s fee is deferred. [s2]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes, invitations require submission. [s2]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
MyAccount tracks electronic requests and receipt after indexing, which can take business days. Paper/PDF
letters sent directly to program are not inherently tracked. [s2]

Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
MyAccount cancel incomplete request, edit contact, resend or add recommender. Received-letter
replacement/reuse unverified. [s2]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Resume/CV listed among required materials; upload online. No public length/format limit. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required brief essay; paraphrase: academic/career goals, how program helps, research interests/experience
and educational accomplishments. About 500 words recommended, not a hard limit; online statement suffices
without duplicate. [s1]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Publications list; Course-list document;
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
The public mathematics and graduate-admissions pages checked do not establish a separate requirement or
permission to submit this item. Required/optional status, exact prompt, length, formatting and
upload-versus-link instructions remain unverified; check the current portal before drafting or sending an extra
document. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Included in SOP; separate essay not publicly established. [s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
Central policy permits additional uploaded documents not expressly requested, which programs may review;
math-specific preference, paper upload vslink and length unverified. [s3]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
Mandatory Supplemental Applicant Information Word form via email/mail. Contents and limits could not be
retrieved from official-linked Box document; obtain from department. [s1] [s5]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Undated academic-year TA stipend range$19,000-$24,000; summer support available but not guaranteed.
Current 2027-28 stipend/tuition/health/fee coverage unverified. [s4]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Most admitted degree students receive TAs; guaranteed years not published on checked funding page. [s4]
International eligibility; Extra funding application [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
TA normally 20 hours/week; initially recitations/grading/office hours/help room, later independent teaching. [s4]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Tuition Scholarship Award, Brown Trust, Lambert, Wolfe and Miller fellowships listed; exact international
eligibility, amounts and separate applications unresolved. [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$100 international standard fee, but Mathematics/Applied Mathematics charge only those who matriculate, on
first university bill. No application payment needed initially. [s1] [s3]

Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Central waivers onlyMcNair; mathematics deferral applies to all. FAQ allows asking program about other
vouchers; no international permanent waiver promise. [s1] [s2]

materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Fee deferred until enrollment, not permanently waived.
• Referee invitations occur only after submission.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
International U.S.-degree applicants contemplated; UChicago bachelor’s is a relevant route. Exact program
GPA/prerequisites must be checked with program. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Submit application early: referee invitations only sent after submission/fee if applicable. Math defers fee until
enrollment. Required supplemental applicant-information Word form must additionally be emailed/mailed;
linked Box file was inaccessible. [s1] [s2] [s5]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
No public requirement to secure an adviser before submitting was established in the admissions pages
checked. Use the research-fit shortlist for potential contacts and confirm 2027 availability/graduate supervision
eligibility. A faculty listing does not promise an opening. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Admissions MyAccount for uploads/status/references after submission. Uploaded documents can be
supplemented but not removed; separate program applications each need materials. [s2] [s3]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Standing February 1; no explicit Fall 2027 date; stipend undated. [s1] [s4]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Standing rule]
February 1 for full fall consideration; year and time zone not specified. [s1]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Full consideration requires all materials by February 1; specific fellowship deadlines unverified. [s1]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Use February 1 full-materials date; no separate letter grace found. [s1]
Test-score receipt [Conflict]
Department asks official English scores before February 1 and 3-4 weeks transit; central FAQ permits unofficial
evaluation then official if admitted. Confirm math application requirement. [s1] [s2]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
February 1 full consideration. Official finals promptly after offer: if degree complete, within 4 weeks;
registration hold if missing by 10thday of term. [s1] [s2]

Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Accept/decline through MyAccount; no acceptance fee. Current commitment date not established; offer
controls. [s2]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Math old TOEFL 79,IELTS 7,PTE 53,DET 115. Central updated TOEFL 4.5 for tests from Jan 21, 2026; central
IELTS 6.5 is lower than math’s7. NoTSE/TWE required. [s1] [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Math exempts bachelor’s/master’s earned at U.S.institution. Completed UChicago degree qualifies; expected
degree at application needs confirmation. [s1]
GRE General [Standing rule]
No longer required. Voluntary-score consideration not explicitly settled. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
GRE generally not required; separate mathematics-test recommendation/consideration not stated. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Math requests every college attended. Upload scans of official records/degree statements; central instructions
reject web grade reports. Official final records after admission; translations alongside originals. [s1] [s3]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
The public admissions checklist checked does not establish a separate mathematics course-list requirement.
Confirm any portal-only supplement and its format; omission here does not mean unsolicited uploads are
permitted. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
The public admissions checklist checked does not establish a separate course-description/textbook-list
requirement. Confirm any portal-only supplement and its format; omission here does not mean unsolicited
uploads are permitted. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three able to assess mathematical potential; REU supervisor encouraged. Nonmathematical letters may be
additional, not replace three. [s1]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
This specific reference detail was not established by the public program/graduate application instructions
checked. Confirm it in the current referee-help screen or with admissions before entering contacts; no
invitation was triggered during research. [s1] [s2] [s3]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
ONLY after application submitted and fee paid if applicable; math’s fee is deferred. [s2]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes, invitations require submission. [s2]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
MyAccount tracks electronic requests and receipt after indexing, which can take business days. Paper/PDF
letters sent directly to program are not inherently tracked. [s2]

Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
MyAccount cancel incomplete request, edit contact, resend or add recommender. Received-letter
replacement/reuse unverified. [s2]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Resume/CV listed among required materials; upload online. No public length/format limit. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required brief essay; paraphrase: academic/career goals, how program helps, research interests/experience
and educational accomplishments. About 500 words recommended, not a hard limit; online statement suffices
without duplicate. [s1]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Publications list; Course-list document;
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
The public mathematics and graduate-admissions pages checked do not establish a separate requirement or
permission to submit this item. Required/optional status, exact prompt, length, formatting and
upload-versus-link instructions remain unverified; check the current portal before drafting or sending an extra
document. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Included in SOP; separate essay not publicly established. [s1]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Unresolved]
Central policy permits additional uploaded documents not expressly requested, which programs may review;
math-specific preference, paper upload vslink and length unverified. [s3]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
Mandatory Supplemental Applicant Information Word form via email/mail. Contents and limits could not be
retrieved from official-linked Box document; obtain from department. [s1] [s5]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Undated academic-year TA stipend range$19,000-$24,000; summer support available but not guaranteed.
Current 2027-28 stipend/tuition/health/fee coverage unverified. [s4]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Most admitted degree students receive TAs; guaranteed years not published on checked funding page. [s4]
International eligibility; Extra funding application [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
TA normally 20 hours/week; initially recitations/grading/office hours/help room, later independent teaching. [s4]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Tuition Scholarship Award, Brown Trust, Lambert, Wolfe and Miller fellowships listed; exact international
eligibility, amounts and separate applications unresolved. [s4]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$100 international standard fee, but Mathematics/Applied Mathematics charge only those who matriculate, on
first university bill. No application payment needed initially. [s1] [s3]

Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Central waivers onlyMcNair; mathematics deferral applies to all. FAQ allows asking program about other
vouchers; no international permanent waiver promise. [s1] [s2]

Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Math asks official English scores bydeadline while central permits unofficial review; math IELTS 7 vs central
6.5. Follow higher math threshold and verify score logistics. [s1] [s2]

Obtain inaccessible supplemental form/current 2027 details; verify funding, Englishexpecteddegree waiver,
